title: Ma Gomba wants Poison

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: There you are. I was hoping you'd stop by.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There you are. I was hoping you'd stop by.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: To impress me. I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To impress me. I have a favor to ask. A little quid pro quo.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Haven't I always had your best interests at heart?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't I always had your best interests at heart?

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: It's quite simple. I need you to grow a mushroom for me. A special kind. Not for eating. I'll pay you 300 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's quite simple. I need you to grow a mushroom for me. A special kind. Not for eating. I'll pay you 300 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: If I hadn't, you would know about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I hadn't, you would know about it.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Then consider our acquaintance terminated. I have no time for parasites.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then consider our acquaintance terminated. I have no time for parasites.
Let's call it a surprise.

nodes.speaker: Ma Gomba
nodes.text: Wonderful. Here are the spores. When it's grown, come and see me for payment. That's all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wonderful. Here are the spores. When it's grown, come and see me for payment. That's all.
To do what?
Why's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would I be interested in helping you even more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would I be interested in helping you even more?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would I be interested in helping you even more?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would I be interested in helping you even more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening...
I doubt that.
I don't know. HAVE you?
Alright, I'll bite.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever it is, I'm going to pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever it is, I'm going to pass.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Whatever it is, I'm going to pass.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Whatever it is, I'm going to pass.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what's it for...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Say no more. I'll grow it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say no more. I'll grow it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Say no more. I'll grow it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Say no more. I'll grow it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's not. I'm out.
Fine by me.
